title: Fire Ready! Exercise & Expo
subtitle: May 4–9, 2026 — La Plata County
keyMessage: The 6th Annual Fire Ready! Exercise begins May 4. You may receive drill notifications from LPC Alerts — use them to practice your plan!

why.title: What is the Fire Ready! Exercise?
paragraphs: A week-long, multi-agency fire training exercise to prepare agencies and the public for wildfire season. Activities include simulated wildfire incidents, EOC activation, Incident Management Team training, and drill notifications sent to LPC Alerts subscribers.
May 2: Live IPAWS Test Alert at 12:00 p.m.
May 4–8: Simulated wildfire exercise with LPC Alerts drill notifications, LPEA Public Safety Power Shutdown (drill only), and Rapid Evac Tag check-in.
May 9: Fire Ready! Expo at La Plata County Fairgrounds, 10 AM – 3 PM. Free, family-friendly event with expert panels, workshops, and demonstrations.

noAccount.title: Not signed up for LPC Alerts?
paragraphs: LPC Alerts is La Plata County's emergency notification system, replacing the former CodeRED system. All residents need to sign up to receive alerts about wildfires, evacuations, floods, and other emergencies.
Signing up now means you'll receive the exercise drill notifications — a great way to test that your alerts are working before fire season.
